name: Forchach
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily situated in Neustift in the Stubai valley, Forchach welcomes visitors with warm Tyrolean care. The comfortably appointed rooms feature pleasant amenities and balconies with mountain views.

The snow-sure Stubai Glacier ski resort and the valley's scenic hiking peaks are comfortably reached within minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Accommodation Forchach in Neustift in the Stubaital offers family relaxation and glacier views in the heart of the Stubai Alps.
